// Soul Strike · Nidhogg (inner script, every client). Step 1 = the drawing, step 2 = the hurl pose, the cues, the guard (2026-11-28).

// pale owner ember flies home to its owner. End = gate + tailHitMs (about 2.7 s).

// MISS (Pierce): the ball clips the target's shoulder: a half burst + a half stun; it sheds half its mass in a burst

// of puffs (radius by sqrt(new HP)), ricochets up and back on a low arc to its own spot and re-forms there at its

// normal, and the real token is handed back. End = gate + tailMissMs (about 3.3 s).

// the fragment (it comes apart at the graze).

// px per pixel, NEAREST, redrawn in the renderer's prerender at the user's effects frame rate. Puffs = soul-fx-lib

// puffField, the ball = soul-fx-lib fireHead. The fragment is DELETED at the gate on a hit: everything about it is

// cached at the start and guarded by tok.destroyed. The gate fires exactly once on every path. No backticks in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const FRAG_NS = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const isFrag = (t) => { try { return t.document.flags[FRAG_NS].soulFragment === true; } catch (e) { return false; } };

const fragHp = (t) => { try { const v = t.actor && t.actor.system && t.actor.system.props && t.actor.system.props.current_hp; return v == null || v === "" || isNaN(Number(v)) ? null : Number(v); } catch (e) { return null; } };

// STRIKE-PLAN-BEGIN (a copy of soul-tithe.js whole / rankFragments / planStrike; tools/anim-studio/test/soul-strike.test.mjs

// asserts copy == module on random lists. Importing the module would run its registry imports on every client)

const whole = (v) => { const n = Math.floor(Number(v)); return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0; };

function rankFragments(list) {

const slot = (f) => (Number.isFinite(f.slot) && f.slot >= 0 ? f.slot : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);

return [...(list || [])].filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => whole(b.hp) - whole(a.hp) || whole(b.max) - whole(a.max) || slot(a) - slot(b));

}

function planStrike(o) {

o = o || {};

const live = (o.list || []).filter((f) => f && whole(f.hp) > 0);

const top = rankFragments(live)[0];

if (!top) return null;

const amount = whole(top.hp);

const loss = o.hit ? amount : o.pierceMiss ? Math.ceil(amount / 2) : 0;

return { fragmentId: top.id, amount, loss, newHp: amount - loss, destroys: loss > 0 && amount - loss <= 0 };

// STRIKE-PLAN-END

const TAG = "[ONI][Soul Strike]";

const bodyBox = (tok) => {

try {

const s = S3(); const b = s && s.drawnMeshBounds ? s.drawnMeshBounds(tok) : tok.mesh.getBounds(false);

if (b && b.width > 0) {

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

} catch (e) {}

try { return { x0: tok.x, y0: tok.y, w: tok.w, h: tok.h }; } catch (e) { return { x0: 0, y0: 0, w: 1, h: 1 }; }

};

const screenRectE = () => {

const r = canvas.app.renderer, W = r.screen.width, H = r.screen.height;

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(0, 0), b = inv(W, H);

return { x0: a.x * D, y0: a.y * D, x1: b.x * D, y1: b.y * D };

};

const ptOf = (tok) => { const b = bodyBox(tok); return { cx: (b.x0 + b.w / 2) * D, cy: (b.y0 + b.h * 0.45) * D, fy: (b.y0 + b.h) * D, ty: b.y0 * D, x0: b.x0 * D, w: b.w * D, h: b.h * D }; };

// the TokenMagic float this frame (effect px, + = down; Confluence's floatE), read on the app's ticker

const floatE = (tok) => {

try {

const mesh = tok && !tok.destroyed ? tok.mesh : null, fs = mesh && mesh.filters;

const tokAlpha = (t) => { try { const a = Number(t.mesh && t.mesh.alpha); return a > 0.05 && a <= 1 ? a : 1; } catch (e) { return 1; } };

const RIG = cfg.rig === undefined ? "hurl" : cfg.rig; // RIG HOOK: "hurl" (step 2); "beamBreath" = the step-1 stand-in; null / "none" = no pose

const fallbackPose = (t) => { // the pose's own curve (rig-motions.js) when the live pose is not readable; rest otherwise

props.description:
• Pierce

Nidhogg hurls his strongest Soul Fragment, the one with the most current HP, at one enemy. On a hit, the target and the fragment each take 【the fragment's current HP】 Poison damage. On a miss, both take half. The fragment always loses the full amount; the target's defences reduce only the target's damage.

A fragment that is destroyed goes back to its owner without healing them: their Max HP is restored, their current HP is not.

Every creature hit by one of Nidhogg's attacks, skills or spells (whatever damage it takes, even none) loses its Poison Resistance, Immunity and Absorption until the end of the round, or until Nidhogg falls. A Poison Vulnerability is not lost.

The action that lands the hit is not affected; only the damage that comes after it is.

// Tail Stab · Nidhogg (inner script, every client).

try {

const tex = (buf) => PIXI.Texture.fromBuffer(new Uint8Array(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, SZ * SZ * 4), SZ, SZ, { scaleMode: PIXI.SCALE_MODES.NEAREST, alphaMode: PIXI.ALPHA_MODES.UNPACK });

if (SL && F.puffs.length) SL.puffField(PX.painterFor(F.frame), F.puffs, u);

// the bloom: flares green as the point lands, then breathes down with the flame

const flare = u < OUT_S ? Math.max(0, u / OUT_S) * 0.5 : Math.exp(-(u - OUT_S) / 0.2);

F.bl.alpha = (cfg.bloomAlpha || 0.55) * Math.max(flare, 0.35 * k);

for (const s of [F.cs, F.ls]) { try { s.texture.baseTexture.resource.update(); } catch (e) {} }

placeFx(g);

}

const dt = performance.now() - c0; cost.n++; cost.sum += dt; if (dt > cost.max) cost.max = dt;

if (cfg.debug) globalThis.__nidCost = { avg: +(cost.sum / cost.n).toFixed(3), max: +cost.max.toFixed(3), n: cost.n };

}

// ── run ──

const rig = oni.rig.play(caster, "tailStrike", {});

t0 = performance.now();

ready();

for (const c of cfg.sfx || []) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.6, delay: c.at || 0 }); } catch (e) {} }

for (const g of TG) {

if (!g.hit) continue;

for (const c of cfg.hitSfx || []) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.6, delay: Math.max(0, g.hitAt + (c.dt || 0)) }); } catch (e) {} }

}

const tkr = canvas.app.ticker;

tickFn = () => { try { tick(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[ONI][Tail Stab] frame threw", e); } };

tkr.add(tickFn);

try {

await wait(GATE);

tick();

gate();

await wait(Math.max(0, TOTAL - GATE));

try { await Promise.race([rig.done, wait(800)]); } catch (e) {}

} finally {

try { tkr.remove(tickFn); } catch (e) {}

for (const g of TG) dropFx(g);

try { root.parent && root.parent.removeChild(root); root.destroy({ children: true }); } catch (e) {}

gate();

}

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 10000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, hits: hitMap(), strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Tail Stab" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

// Call of the Master — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js

// Re-run: node tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js --out <file>

(async () => {

const CFG = {"roarHold":1,"peakMs":1100,"chargeMs":250,"launchMs":950,"dropMs":60,"travelMs":400,"gateLagMs":100,"fadeMs":600,"stunMs":110,"totalMs":3000,"totalTimeoutMs":15000,"squash":0.5,"dim":0.3,"shake":9,"shakeMs":800,"flashAlpha":0.16,"sfx":[{"at":800,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Monster5.ogg","v":0.75},{"at":950,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness4.ogg","v":0.6},{"at":1000,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Wind1.ogg","v":0.55},{"at":1340,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Poison.ogg","v":0.6}]};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.nidhogg.call-of-the-master";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Call of the Master]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

function hitMap() {

try {

const d = globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.experimental?.battleDirector?.getActiveDirector?.();

const r = d?.ctx?.actionResult?.perTargetResults;

if (!Array.isArray(r) || !r.length) return null;

const o = {};

for (const x of r) if (x?.tokenUuid) o[x.tokenUuid] = x.hit !== false;

return o;

} catch (_) { return null; }

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// Call of the Master · Nidhogg (inner script, every client).

// He roars; at the jaw snap a ring of his green soul fire leaves his feet and runs out

// across the whole floor, through the party. Each target it reaches flares in soul

// fire and turns green (a colour wash on its own mesh). Damage gate (fireDone) once

// the front has passed the farthest target; the ring then cools and fades past them.

// After the gate the engine tears each HIT target's soul (Soul Tithe's own show),

// which this script does not draw.

// Pixel FX: drawn on CPU frames in "field space" (effect px = world px x D, the

// scene's rest-view scale, so 1 effect px = 1 screen px at the battle view), the

// soul-fire puff field and ramps from soul-fx-lib, placed where the 3D camera draws

// the floor (projectFoot). Back half of the ring under the battlers, front half over.

// No backticks in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const hits = ctx.params.hits || null;

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && !t.destroyed && t.mesh);

const readyHook = ctx.params.readyHook;

const ready = () => { if (readyHook) { try { Hooks.callAll(readyHook); } catch (e) {} } };

let gated = false;

const gate = () => { if (gated) return; gated = true; oni.fireDone(); };

if (!caster || !caster.mesh || !canvas || !canvas.ready) { ready(); gate(); return; }

const route = (p) => { try { return foundry.utils.getRoute(p); } catch (e) { return "/" + p; } };

const MOD = "modules/fabula-ultima-companion/scripts/";

let PX = null, SL = null;

try {

PX = await import(route(MOD + "battle-director/pixel-entrance/pixelfx/core/index.js"));

SL = await import(route(MOD + "conflict-event/soul-fx/soul-fx-lib.js"));

} catch (e) { console.warn("[ONI][Call of the Master] pixel fx unavailable", e); }

// ── timing (ms from the roar's start) ──

const HOLD = cfg.roarHold != null ? cfg.roarHold : 1.4;

const rigT = oni.rig.timing ? oni.rig.timing("roar", { hold: HOLD }) : null;

const PEAK = (rigT && rigT.peakMs) || cfg.peakMs || 1100; // the jaw snap (full gape)

const ROAR_END = (rigT && rigT.durationMs) || (PEAK + (HOLD + 1.1) * 1000);

const CHARGE0 = cfg.chargeMs != null ? cfg.chargeMs : 250;

// the launch: the roar comes out of his mouth (the jaw is opening, 0.8 -> 1.1 s; the roar sound is up)

const LAUNCH = cfg.launchMs || 950;

const DROP = cfg.dropMs != null ? cfg.dropMs : 60; // mouth burst -> the ring starts on the floor under it

const WAVE0 = LAUNCH + DROP;

const TW = cfg.travelMs || 400; // ring start -> the front reaches the farthest target

const GATE = WAVE0 + TW + (cfg.gateLagMs != null ? cfg.gateLagMs : 100);

const STUN_MS = cfg.stunMs || 110; // hit stun: white-green flash frame + jolt

const FADE_MS = cfg.fadeMs || 800; // the front cools out after the farthest target

const WASH_IN = 140, WASH_HOLD_TO = GATE + 300, WASH_OUT = 900;

const TOTAL = Math.max(cfg.totalMs || 3600, ROAR_END);

const SQ = cfg.squash || 0.5; // the ring on the 2D floor: y half-axis / x half-axis

const K_EASE = 0.35; // gentle slow-down of the front (0 = constant speed)

// ── space ──

const S3 = () => globalThis.__ONI_BATTLE_STAGE_3D__ || null;

let D = 1;

try { const v = globalThis.FUCompanion.api.camera.restViewFor(canvas.scene); if (v && v.scale > 0) D = v.scale; } catch (e) {}

if (!(D > 0)) D = canvas.stage.scale.x || 1;

const meshBox2d = (tok) => {

try {

const b = tok.mesh.getBounds(false);

if (b && b.width > 0) {

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.primary.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(b.x, b.y), c = inv(b.x + b.width, b.y + b.height);

return { x0: a.x, y0: a.y, w: c.x - a.x, h: c.y - a.y };

}

} catch (e) {}

return { x0: tok.x, y0: tok.y, w: tok.w, h: tok.h };

};

// 2D feet (the floor point the camera plants the token on)

const foot2d = (tok) => {

const m = S3() && S3().drawnMap ? S3().drawnMap(tok) : null;

if (m && Number.isFinite(m.fx)) return { x: m.fx, y: m.fy };

const g = meshBox2d(tok); return { x: g.x0 + g.w / 2, y: g.y0 + g.h };

};

// where a 2D floor point is drawn now (world px) and its drawn scale

const proj = (x, y) => {

const s = S3(); let q = null;

try { q = s && s.projectFoot ? s.projectFoot({ x, y }) : null; } catch (e) { q = null; }

return q && Number.isFinite(q.x) ? { x: q.x, y: q.y, m: q.m || 1 } : { x, y, m: 1 };

};

// a token's drawn body box in world px

const bodyBox = (tok) => {

try {

const s = S3(); const b = s && s.drawnMeshBounds ? s.drawnMeshBounds(tok) : tok.mesh.getBounds(false);

if (b && b.width > 0) {

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(b.x, b.y), c = inv(b.x + b.width, b.y + b.height);

return { x0: a.x, y0: a.y, w: c.x - a.x, h: c.y - a.y };

}

} catch (e) {}

return meshBox2d(tok);

};

const screenRectE = () => {

const r = canvas.app.renderer, W = r.screen.width, H = r.screen.height;

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(0, 0), b = inv(W, H);

return { x0: a.x * D, y0: a.y * D, x1: b.x * D, y1: b.y * D };

};

// ── his mouth: a point on the painting carried by the rig's live pose (rig.json: jaw / neck pivots), placed

// on his 2D mesh (mirrored when he faces right) and moved to where the 3D camera draws him ──

const ART = cfg.art || { w: 859, h: 837, mouth: [112, 532], jaw: [193, 503], neck: [262, 468] };

const D2R = Math.PI / 180;

const roarPose = (t) => { // the roar motion's own curve (rig-motions.js), used when the live pose is not readable

const J = 32, HD = 16, t1 = 0.8, t2 = 1.1, t3 = t2 + HOLD, t4 = t3 + 1.1;

const ob = (x) => { const c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1; return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(x - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(x - 1, 2); };

const es = (x) => 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * x);

if (t < t1) { const e = es(t / t1); return { jaw: -5 * e, lift: -5 * e }; }

if (t < t2) { const e = ob((t - t1) / (t2 - t1)); return { jaw: -5 + (J + 5) * e, lift: -5 + (HD + 5) * e }; }

if (t < t3) return { jaw: J, lift: HD };

if (t < t4) { const e = es((t - t3) / (t4 - t3)); return { jaw: J * (1 - e), lift: HD * (1 - e) }; }

return { jaw: 0, lift: 0 };

};

const livePose = (el) => {

try { const rec = globalThis.__ONI_CREATURE_RIG__._debug.rec(caster); const p = rec && rec.model && rec.model.lastPose; if (p && Number.isFinite(p.lift)) return p; } catch (e) {}

return roarPose(el / 1000);

};

const rot = (v, c, a) => { const x = v[0] - c[0], y = v[1] - c[1], co = Math.cos(a), si = Math.sin(a); return [c[0] + x * co - y * si, c[1] + x * si + y * co]; };

const toM = (p) => [p[0] - ART.w / 2, ART.h - p[1]];

function mouth2d(el) {

const ps = livePose(el);

let v = rot(toM(ART.mouth), toM(ART.jaw), (ps.jaw || 0) * D2R * 0.5); // half way between the jaws

v = rot(v, toM(ART.neck), -(ps.lift || 0) * D2R);

const sx = v[0] + ART.w / 2, sy = ART.h - v[1];

const b = meshBox2d(caster), flip = (Number(caster.document.texture.scaleX) || 1) < 0;

return { x: b.x0 + (flip ? 1 - sx / ART.w : sx / ART.w) * b.w, y: b.y0 + (sy / ART.h) * b.h };

}

function mouthE(el) { // effect px, where it is drawn now

const p = mouth2d(el), m = S3() && S3().drawnMap ? S3().drawnMap(caster) : null;

const w = m && Number.isFinite(m.fx) ? { x: m.bx + (p.x - m.fx) * m.m, y: m.by + (p.y - m.fy) * m.m, m: m.m } : { x: p.x, y: p.y, m: 1 };

return { x: w.x * D, y: w.y * D, m: w.m };

}

// ── the plan: the ring starts on the floor right under his mouth; each target's distance on the ring ──

const F2 = foot2d(caster);

const cBox = meshBox2d(caster);

// the floor under his mouth at the row his claws stand on (the bottom of his painting); for a giant the token's own

// foot point sits up at his chest

const C2 = { x: mouth2d(LAUNCH).x, y: Math.max(F2.y, cBox.y0 + cBox.h * (cfg.floorFrac || 0.96)) };

const R0 = cfg.r0 || 40;

const rhoOf = (p) => Math.hypot(p.x - C2.x, (p.y - C2.y) / SQ);

const TG = targets.map((t) => { const f = foot2d(t); return { tok: t, f, rho: Math.max(R0 + 1, rhoOf(f)), hit: hits ? hits[t.document.uuid] !== false : true }; });

const RMAX = TG.length ? Math.max(...TG.map((g) => g.rho)) : (cfg.rDefault || 1000);

const EK = 1 - Math.exp(-K_EASE);

const gOf = (u) => (K_EASE > 0 ? (1 - Math.exp(-K_EASE * u)) / EK : u);

const uOf = (y) => (K_EASE > 0 ? -Math.log(1 - y * EK) / K_EASE : y);

const radiusAt = (el) => { const u = (el - WAVE0) / TW; return u <= 0 ? R0 : R0 + (RMAX - R0) * (u <= 1 ? gOf(u) : 1 + (u - 1) * K_EASE * Math.exp(-K_EASE) / EK); };

for (const g of TG) g.at = WAVE0 + TW * uOf((g.rho - R0) / Math.max(1, RMAX - R0));

if (cfg.debug) globalThis.__cotmPlan = { D, PEAK, LAUNCH, WAVE0, TW, GATE, C2, mouth: mouth2d(LAUNCH), TOTAL, R0, RMAX, hits: TG.map((g) => ({ name: g.tok.name, at: Math.round(g.at), hit: g.hit })) };

const seg = (t, a, b) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - a) / (b - a)));

const sine = (k) => 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * k);

const R = (() => { let s = 0x2545F491; return () => { s ^= s << 13; s ^= s >>> 17; s ^= s << 5; return ((s >>> 0) % 100000) / 100000; }; })();

const rr = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

// ── layers: frames shown as colour + additive light sprites ──

const FX = !!(PX && SL);

const backRoot = new PIXI.Container(); backRoot.name = "oni-cotm-back"; backRoot.eventMode = "none"; backRoot.scale.set(1 / D);

const frontRoot = new PIXI.Container(); frontRoot.name = "oni-cotm-front"; frontRoot.eventMode = "none"; frontRoot.scale.set(1 / D); frontRoot.zIndex = 95000;

const dimG = new PIXI.Graphics(); backRoot.addChild(dimG);

canvas.primary.addChild(backRoot);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true; canvas.stage.addChild(frontRoot);

const reindex = () => {

const kids = canvas.primary.children; let first = -1;

for (let i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) { const n = kids[i] && kids[i].name; if (typeof n === "string" && n.indexOf("Token.") === 0) { first = i; break; } }

const want = first < 0 ? kids.length - 1 : Math.max(0, first - 1), cur = kids.indexOf(backRoot);

if (cur >= 0 && cur !== want) { try { canvas.primary.setChildIndex(backRoot, Math.min(want, kids.length - 1)); } catch (e) {} }

};

const bufTex = (buf, w, h) => PIXI.Texture.fromBuffer(new Uint8Array(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, w * h * 4), w, h, { scaleMode: PIXI.SCALE_MODES.NEAREST, alphaMode: PIXI.ALPHA_MODES.UNPACK });

// A layer is a grid of 128 px tiles (colour + additive light sprite each), made on demand and drawn only where

// this frame has something: the ring is a thin arc across the whole screen, so one frame over its bbox would be

// ~1M px cleared and uploaded twice a tick for a few percent of lit pixels.

const TS = 128;

function Layer(parent) { this.parent = parent; this.tiles = new Map(); }

// bands: [{ x0, y0, x1, y1, draw(p) }], puffs, sparks, lights: [{ x, y, r, c, k }]

Layer.prototype.draw = function (bands, plist, sp, lights, tSec) {

const use = new Map();

const slot = (k) => { let u = use.get(k); if (!u) use.set(k, (u = { b: [], p: [], s: [], l: [] })); return u; };

const span = (x0, y0, x1, y1, key, it) => {

const ax = Math.floor(x0 / TS), bx = Math.floor(x1 / TS), ay = Math.floor(y0 / TS), by = Math.floor(y1 / TS);

if (bx - ax > 40 || by - ay > 40) return;

for (let ty = ay; ty <= by; ty++) for (let tx = ax; tx <= bx; tx++) slot(tx + "," + ty)[key].push(it);

};

for (const it of bands) span(it.x0, it.y0, it.x1, it.y1, "b", it);

for (const q of plist) span(q.x - q.s * 4.5 - 2, q.y - q.s * 4.7 - 2, q.x + q.s * 4.5 + 2, q.y + q.s * 1.7 + 2, "p", q);

for (const q of sp) span(q.x, q.y, q.x, q.y, "s", q);

for (const it of lights) span(it.x - it.r, it.y - it.r, it.x + it.r, it.y + it.r, "l", it);

for (const [k, t] of this.tiles) if (!use.has(k)) { t.c.visible = false; t.l.visible = false; }

for (const [k, u] of use) {

let t = this.tiles.get(k);

if (!t) {

const c = k.split(","), f = PX.createFrame(TS, TS, +c[0] * TS, +c[1] * TS);

const cs = new PIXI.Sprite(bufTex(f.color, TS, TS)), ls = new PIXI.Sprite(bufTex(f.light, TS, TS));

ls.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; cs.position.set(f.ox, f.oy); ls.position.set(f.ox, f.oy);

this.parent.addChild(cs, ls); this.tiles.set(k, (t = { f, c: cs, l: ls }));

}

PX.clearFrame(t.f);

const p = PX.painterFor(t.f);

for (const it of u.b) it.draw(p);

// the merged soul-fire field (soul-fx-lib): it reads 1 px past the frame, so tile edges see true neighbours

if (u.p.length) SL.puffField(p, u.p, tSec);

for (const q of u.s) { const a = 1 - q.age / q.life; p.put(Math.round(q.x), Math.round(q.y), q.c === 7 ? PX.WHITE : C[q.c], a > 0.5 ? 1 : a * 2); }

for (const it of u.l) glowClip(p, it.x, it.y, it.r, it.c, it.k);

for (const s2 of [t.c, t.l]) { s2.visible = true; try { s2.texture.baseTexture.resource.update(); } catch (e) {} }

}

};

Layer.prototype.destroy = function () {

for (const t of this.tiles.values()) for (const s2 of [t.c, t.l]) { try { s2.parent && s2.parent.removeChild(s2); s2.destroy({ texture: true, baseTexture: true }); } catch (e) {} }

this.tiles.clear();

};

// a radial glow into the light buffer, visiting only this tile's pixels

function glowClip(p, x, y, r, c, k) {

if (r < 1 || k <= 0.004) return;

const x0 = Math.max(p.ox, Math.floor(x - r)), x1 = Math.min(p.ox + p.w - 1, Math.ceil(x + r));

const y0 = Math.max(p.oy, Math.floor(y - r)), y1 = Math.min(p.oy + p.h - 1, Math.ceil(y + r));

for (let sy = y0; sy <= y1; sy++) { const dy = (sy + 0.5 - y) / r, dy2 = dy * dy; if (dy2 >= 1) continue;

for (let sx = x0; sx <= x1; sx++) { const dx = (sx + 0.5 - x) / r, d = dx * dx + dy2; if (d >= 1) continue; const f = 1 - Math.sqrt(d); p.add(sx, sy, c, f * f * k); } }

}

const LB = new Layer(backRoot), LF = new Layer(frontRoot);

// ── colour wash on a mesh (green soul light over its own luminance) ──

const CMF = PIXI.ColorMatrixFilter || (PIXI.filters && PIXI.filters.ColorMatrixFilter);

const GREEN = [0.42, 1.0, 0.5];

const washM = (k, lift) => {

const L = [0.299, 0.587, 0.114], m = [];

for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {

for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) m.push((r === c ? 1 - k : 0) + k * GREEN[r] * lift * L[c]);

m.push(0, 0);

}

m.push(0, 0, 0, 1, 0);

return m;

};

const washes = new Map();

const setWash = (tok, k, lift) => {

if (!CMF || !tok || tok.destroyed || !tok.mesh || tok.mesh.destroyed) return;

let f = washes.get(tok);

if (k <= 0.01) { if (f) { const fs = tok.mesh.filters || []; if (fs.indexOf(f) >= 0) tok.mesh.filters = fs.filter((x) => x !== f); } return; }

if (!f) { f = new CMF(); f.resolution = canvas.app.renderer.resolution || 1; washes.set(tok, f); }

f.matrix = washM(k, lift);

const fs = tok.mesh.filters || [];

if (fs.indexOf(f) < 0) tok.mesh.filters = fs.concat([f]);

};

const dropWashes = () => { for (const [tok, f] of washes) { try { const fs = (tok.mesh && tok.mesh.filters) || []; if (fs.indexOf(f) >= 0) tok.mesh.filters = fs.filter((x) => x !== f); f.destroy && f.destroy(); } catch (e) {} } washes.clear(); };

// ── the simulation (effect px) ──

const puffs = { b: [], f: [] }, sparks = { b: [], f: [] };

const step = (list, dt) => { for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const q = list[i]; q.age += dt; if (q.age >= q.life) { list.splice(i, 1); continue; } q.x += q.vx * dt; q.y += q.vy * dt; q.vx *= Math.pow(0.2, dt); q.vy *= Math.pow(0.55, dt); } };

// a soul-fire puff: rises, and carries the push it was born with (vx0, vy0: the front's own motion)

const spawnPuff = (L, x, y, m, k, up, vx0, vy0, big) => puffs[L].push({ kind: "puff", x, y, vx: (vx0 || 0) + rr(-12, 12) * m, vy: (vy0 || 0) - rr(35, 80) * m * (up || 1), age: 0, life: rr(0.16, 0.3) * (0.75 + 0.35 * k) * (big ? 1.4 : 1), s: rr(3.6, 6.4) * m * Math.max(0.7, D) * (0.65 + 0.45 * k) * (big || 1), f: R() });

const spawnSpark = (L, x, y, m) => sparks[L].push({ x, y, vx: rr(-25, 25) * m, vy: -rr(60, 150) * m, age: 0, life: rr(0.25, 0.5), c: R() < 0.4 ? 7 : R() < 0.6 ? 6 : 5 });

const C = SL ? SL.SOUL : null, FH = SL ? SL.FH : null, GLOW = SL ? SL.GLOW : 0;

// the band behind the front: v 0 = the front edge .. 1 = inner fade

const bandCol = (v) => (v < 0.07 ? [FH[0], 1] : v < 0.17 ? [FH[1], 1] : v < 0.3 ? [FH[2], 0.95] : v < 0.48 ? [FH[3], 0.8] : v < 0.7 ? [FH[5], 0.55] : [FH[6], 0.38 * (1.6 - v)]);

// the floor the ring may run on: the conflict stage rect (2D), faded over its last EDGE px

const STG = (() => { try { const st = canvas.scene.flags["fabula-ultima-companion"].conflict.stage; if (st && st.w > 0) return st; } catch (e) {} const d = canvas.dimensions.sceneRect; return { x: d.x, y: d.y, w: d.width, h: d.height }; })();

const EDGE = cfg.edgePx || 70;

const edgeK = (x, y) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (x - STG.x) / EDGE, (STG.x + STG.w - x) / EDGE, (y - STG.y) / EDGE, (STG.y + STG.h - y) / EDGE));

// one frame of the ring at radius r (2D floor px), strength k: samples split into back (far) / front (near)

// halves, each half sampled end to end so the two meet without a seam

function ringSamples(r, k, tSec, scr, WB) {

const out = { b: [], f: [] };

if (r <= 0 || k <= 0.01) return out;

const n = Math.max(8, Math.ceil(Math.PI / Math.min(0.08, 6 / (r * D))));

for (const L of ["f", "b"]) for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {

const th = (L === "f" ? 0 : Math.PI) + Math.PI * i / n;

const cs = Math.cos(th), sn = Math.sin(th);

const j = 5 * Math.sin(th * 23 + tSec * 9) + 4 * Math.sin(th * 57 - tSec * 13);

const rf = r + j, ri = Math.max(R0 * 0.5, r - WB * (0.85 + 0.3 * Math.sin(th * 11 + tSec * 5)));

const px = C2.x + cs * rf, py = C2.y + sn * rf * SQ;

const F = proj(px, py), B = proj(C2.x + cs * ri, C2.y + sn * ri * SQ);

const fx = F.x * D, fy = F.y * D, bx = B.x * D, by = B.y * D;

const e = edgeK(px, py);

const vis = e > 0 && fx > scr.x0 - 60 && fx < scr.x1 + 60 && fy > scr.y0 - 60 && fy < scr.y1 + 60;

const dl = Math.hypot(fx - bx, fy - by) || 1;

out[L].push({ fx, fy, bx, by, m: F.m, vis, e, th, ux: (fx - bx) / dl, uy: (fy - by) / dl, sc: dl / Math.max(1, rf - ri) });

}

return out;

}

// the band as quads between neighbouring samples (front edge -> inner fade), and the light along the front

function bandItems(S, k, items, lights) {

for (let i = 0; i + 1 < S.length; i++) {

const a = S[i], b = S[i + 1];

if (!a.vis && !b.vis) continue;

const ek = Math.min(a.e, b.e);

if (ek <= 0) continue;

items.push({

x0: Math.min(a.fx, b.fx, a.bx, b.bx) - 1, y0: Math.min(a.fy, b.fy, a.by, b.by) - 1, x1: Math.max(a.fx, b.fx, a.bx, b.bx) + 1, y1: Math.max(a.fy, b.fy, a.by, b.by) + 1,

draw: (p) => {

const along = Math.max(Math.hypot(b.fx - a.fx, b.fy - a.fy), Math.hypot(b.bx - a.bx, b.by - a.by));

const rad = Math.max(Math.hypot(a.bx - a.fx, a.by - a.fy), Math.hypot(b.bx - b.fx, b.by - b.fy));

const na = Math.ceil(along * 1.05) + 1, nr = Math.ceil(rad * 1.05) + 1;

for (let jj = 0; jj <= nr; jj++) {

const v = jj / nr, cc = bandCol(v), al = cc[1] * k * ek;

if (al <= 0.03) continue;

for (let ii = 0; ii <= na; ii++) {

const u = ii / na, x = a.fx + (b.fx - a.fx) * u, y = a.fy + (b.fy - a.fy) * u;

p.put(Math.round(x + (a.bx + (b.bx - a.bx) * u - x) * v), Math.round(y + (a.by + (b.by - a.by) * u - y) * v), cc[0], al);

}

}

},

});

}

for (let i = 0; i < S.length; i += 3) { const s2 = S[i]; if (s2.vis && s2.e > 0) lights.push({ x: s2.fx, y: s2.fy - 4 * s2.m, r: 17 * s2.m * D, c: GLOW, k: 0.2 * k * s2.e }); }

}

// a shock ring off the mouth: a thin pixel ellipse, hot edge first, thinning out as it opens

function shockItem(q, el, items) {

const u = (el - q.at) / 280;

if (u < 0 || u > 1) return;

const rx = (24 + 230 * Math.sqrt(u)) * q.m * D, ry = rx * 0.8, a = 1 - u;

items.push({ x0: q.x - rx - 3, y0: q.y - ry - 3, x1: q.x + rx + 3, y1: q.y + ry + 3, draw: (p) => {

const n = Math.ceil(rx * 7);

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {

const th = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2, c = Math.cos(th), s2 = Math.sin(th);

for (let w = 0; w < 3; w++) p.put(Math.round(q.x + c * (rx - w)), Math.round(q.y + s2 * (ry - w * 0.8)), w === 0 ? FH[0] : w === 1 ? FH[2] : FH[4], a * (w === 2 ? 0.6 : 1));

}

} });

}

// ── the show ──

let t0 = 0, lastSim = -1, tickFn = null, shook = false, firstHit = false, dimK = 0, mouthGlow = null;

const shocks = [];

const DIM = cfg.dim != null ? cfg.dim : 0.3;

const flashes = []; // light bursts { L, x, y, r, at, dur }

function tick() {

const el = performance.now() - t0, tSec = el / 1000;

try { reindex(); } catch (e) {}

// washes on every frame (cheap): targets as the front reaches them, Nidhogg's own flare at the peak

for (const g of TG) {

if (!g.hit) continue;

const st = el - g.at;

if (st >= 0 && st < STUN_MS) {

// hit stun: a white-green flash frame, then the jolt (on the mesh pivot, the house shake: nothing refreshes it)

setWash(g.tok, 1, st < 70 ? 3.2 : 2.0);

const u = st / STUN_MS, m = g.tok.mesh;

if (m && !m.destroyed) { m.pivot.x = Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 5) * (cfg.joltPx || 7) * (1 - u) / (Math.abs(m.scale.x) || 1); g.jolted = true; }

continue;

}

if (g.jolted) { g.jolted = false; try { g.tok.mesh.pivot.x = 0; } catch (e) {} }

const kIn = seg(el, g.at + STUN_MS - 20, g.at + STUN_MS + WASH_IN), kOut = 1 - sine(seg(el, WASH_HOLD_TO, WASH_HOLD_TO + WASH_OUT));

setWash(g.tok, 0.72 * Math.max(kIn, st >= 0 ? 0.6 : 0) * kOut, 1.15);

}

const ck = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(el - LAUNCH - 150) / 600);

setWash(caster, 0.38 * sine(ck), 1.25);

// dim the scene a little so the green reads on the bright valley floor

dimK = DIM * sine(seg(el, 0, 600)) * (1 - sine(seg(el, GATE + 300, GATE + 1100)));

const scr = screenRectE();

dimG.clear(); if (dimK > 0.005) { dimG.beginFill(0x020a06, dimK).drawRect(scr.x0 - (scr.x1 - scr.x0), scr.y0 - (scr.y1 - scr.y0), (scr.x1 - scr.x0) * 3, (scr.y1 - scr.y0) * 3).endFill(); }

if (!FX) return;

// pixels at 30 fps

if (lastSim >= 0 && el - lastSim < 33) return;

const dt = lastSim < 0 ? 1 / 30 : Math.min(0.1, (el - lastSim) / 1000); lastSim = el;

// the charge: soul fire gathers in his mouth as the roar winds up; the ring runs from WAVE0

const MO = mouthE(el), dirX = (TG.length ? TG.reduce((a, g) => a + g.f.x, 0) / TG.length : C2.x + 1) >= C2.x ? 1 : -1;

if (el >= CHARGE0 && el < LAUNCH) {

const u = seg(el, CHARGE0, LAUNCH);

for (let i = 0; i < 2 + Math.round(4 * u); i++) { const a = rr(0, Math.PI * 2), d = rr(18, 46) * MO.m * D, T = rr(0.12, 0.22); puffs.f.push({ kind: "puff", x: MO.x + Math.cos(a) * d, y: MO.y + Math.sin(a) * d, vx: -Math.cos(a) * d / T, vy: -Math.sin(a) * d / T, age: 0, life: T, s: rr(1.6, 3) * MO.m * D * (0.6 + 0.6 * u), f: R() }); }

mouthGlow = { x: MO.x, y: MO.y, r: (20 + 40 * u) * MO.m * D, k: 0.15 + 0.35 * u };

} else mouthGlow = null;

let r = 0, k = 0;

if (el >= WAVE0) { r = radiusAt(el); k = 1 - sine(seg(el, WAVE0 + TW, WAVE0 + TW + FADE_MS)); }

const WB = (28 + 18 * seg(el, WAVE0, WAVE0 + 200)) * (0.6 + 0.4 * k);

const S = ringSamples(r, k, tSec, scr, WB);

// the flow: soul-fire puffs and sparks off the front (rate per sample)

const rate = (cfg.puffRate || 0.3) * k;

const vr = el < WAVE0 ? 0 : (radiusAt(el + 20) - radiusAt(el - 20)) / 0.04; // the front's speed, floor px/s

for (const L of ["b", "f"]) for (const s of S[L]) {

if (!s.vis) continue;

const ride = vr * s.sc * 0.55;

if (R() < rate * s.e) spawnPuff(L, s.fx + rr(-2, 2), s.fy + rr(-2, 2), s.m, k, 1.1, s.ux * ride * 0.6, s.uy * ride * 0.6);

if (R() < rate * 0.05 * s.e) spawnSpark(L, s.fx, s.fy - 3, s.m);

}

// the launch: the roar bursts out of his mouth (a spray of soul fire forward and down to the floor, shock

// rings off the mouth, a flash), and the ring starts on the floor under it

if (!shook && el >= LAUNCH) {

shook = true;

try { oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.shakeMs || 800, intensity: cfg.shake || 9 }); } catch (e) {}

const FL = proj(C2.x, C2.y), floorDy = Math.max(30, FL.y * D - MO.y);

for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {

const a = rr(-0.35, 1.2), sp = rr(250, 700) * MO.m * D; // forward (toward the party) and down

spawnPuff("f", MO.x + rr(-6, 6), MO.y + rr(-6, 6), MO.m, 1, 0.4, dirX * Math.cos(a) * sp, Math.sin(a) * sp * (floorDy / 220), 1.25);

}

for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) spawnSpark("f", MO.x + rr(-10, 10), MO.y + rr(-10, 10), MO.m);

flashes.push({ L: "f", x: MO.x, y: MO.y, r: 150 * MO.m * D, at: el, dur: 450, k: 0.7 });

for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) shocks.push({ at: el + j * 70, x: MO.x, y: MO.y, m: MO.m });

}

// a target the front reaches: soul fire licks up round its feet, a flash at its chest

for (const g of TG) {

if (el < g.at || g.done > 2) continue;

const bb = bodyBox(g.tok), fx = (bb.x0 + bb.w / 2) * D, fy = (bb.y0 + bb.h) * D, m = proj(g.f.x, g.f.y).m;

if (!g.done) {

g.done = 1;

try { oni.hit({ tokenUuid: g.tok.document.uuid, hit: g.hit }); } catch (e) {}

if (g.hit) {

flashes.push({ L: "f", x: fx, y: fy - bb.h * 0.45 * D, r: Math.max(40, bb.w * 0.6) * D, at: el, dur: 380, k: 0.5 });

if (!firstHit) { firstHit = true; try { oni.screenshake({ duration: 260, intensity: 4 }); } catch (e) {} }

}

}

if (!g.hit) { g.done = 3; continue; }

const u = (el - g.at) / 320;

if (u > 1) { g.done = 3; continue; }

const n = Math.round(9 * (1 - u));

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = rr(0, Math.PI * 2); spawnPuff("f", fx + Math.cos(a) * bb.w * 0.34 * D, fy + Math.sin(a) * 6 * m * D, m, 1, 2.2, 0, 0, 1.25); }

if (R() < 0.6) spawnSpark("f", fx + rr(-0.3, 0.3) * bb.w * D, fy - rr(0, 0.6) * bb.h * D, m);

}

step(puffs.b, dt); step(puffs.f, dt); step(sparks.b, dt); step(sparks.f, dt);

for (let i = flashes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (el - flashes[i].at > flashes[i].dur) flashes.splice(i, 1);

for (let i = shocks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (el - shocks[i].at > 280) shocks.splice(i, 1);

for (const L of ["b", "f"]) {

const items = [], lights = [];

bandItems(S[L], k, items, lights);

if (L === "f") {

if (mouthGlow) lights.push({ x: mouthGlow.x, y: mouthGlow.y, r: mouthGlow.r, c: GLOW, k: mouthGlow.k });

for (const q of shocks) shockItem(q, el, items);

}

for (const q of flashes) if (q.L === L) { const a = 1 - (el - q.at) / q.dur; lights.push({ x: q.x, y: q.y, r: q.r, c: GLOW, k: q.k * a * a }, { x: q.x, y: q.y, r: q.r * 0.35, c: PX.WHITE, k: 0.25 * a * a }); }

(L === "b" ? LB : LF).draw(items, puffs[L], sparks[L], lights, tSec);

}

}

// ── run ──

const SFX = cfg.sfx || [];

const roar = oni.rig.roar(caster, { hold: HOLD });

t0 = performance.now();

ready();

for (const c of SFX) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.7, delay: c.at || 0 }); } catch (e) {} }

const tkr = canvas.app.ticker;

tickFn = () => { try { tick(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[ONI][Call of the Master] frame threw", e); } };

tkr.add(tickFn);

const flashT = setTimeout(() => { try { oni.domFlash({ color: "#7dff8a", alpha: cfg.flashAlpha != null ? cfg.flashAlpha : 0.16, fadeIn: 60, hold: 40, fadeOut: 420 }); } catch (e) {} }, LAUNCH);

try {

await wait(GATE);

gate();

await wait(Math.max(0, TOTAL - GATE));

try { await Promise.race([roar.done, wait(1500)]); } catch (e) {}

} finally {

clearTimeout(flashT);

try { tkr.remove(tickFn); } catch (e) {}

for (const g of TG) { try { if (g.tok.mesh) g.tok.mesh.pivot.x = 0; } catch (e) {} }

dropWashes();

LB.destroy(); LF.destroy();

try { backRoot.parent && backRoot.parent.removeChild(backRoot); backRoot.destroy({ children: true }); } catch (e) {}

try { frontRoot.parent && frontRoot.parent.removeChild(frontRoot); frontRoot.destroy({ children: true }); } catch (e) {}

gate();

}

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 15000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, hits: hitMap(), strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Call of the Master" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();
props.description:
• Overflow

Nidhogg roars, and a wave of green soul-fire sweeps the battlefield. Deal 【HR + 20】 Poison damage to all enemies.

Right after the damage lands, Soul Tithe takes each player character hit: their Max HP drops to their current HP, and what they lost forms their Soul Fragment (or is added to the one they already have).

props.animation_script:
// Soulflare — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js

// Re-run: node tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js --out <file>

(async () => {

const CFG = {"chargeMs":1000,"staggerMs":150,"jaw":28,"orbLeadMs":420,"burnMs":1300,"gateLagMs":150,"pixel":2,"boltK":2.4,"flightBaseMs":300,"flightPerPx":0.3,"flightMinMs":380,"flightMaxMs":720,"minGapMs":120,"arcTop":0.3,"arcLow":-0.12,"soloArc":0.18,"burstN":72,"tailRate":520,"tailPerPx":0.9,"burnRate":30,"burnSites":6,"knockPx":11,"dim":0.28,"totalTimeoutMs":12000,"sfx":[{"at":0,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Magic1.ogg","v":0.4},{"at":150,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Absorb1.ogg","v":0.4},{"at":300,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness1.ogg","v":0.35},{"at":780,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Monster4.ogg","v":0.45}],"launchSfx":[{"dt":-20,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Shot1.ogg","v":0.42},{"dt":-20,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Magic3.ogg","v":0.38},{"dt":-20,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Fire2.ogg","v":0.38}],"launchCycle":true,"hitSfx":[{"dt":-10,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Fire1.ogg","v":0.5},{"dt":20,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Poison.ogg","v":0.4}],"burnSfx":[]};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.nidhogg.soulflare";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Soulflare]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

function hitMap() {

try {

const d = globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.experimental?.battleDirector?.getActiveDirector?.();

const r = d?.ctx?.actionResult?.perTargetResults;

if (!Array.isArray(r) || !r.length) return null;

const o = {};

for (const x of r) if (x?.tokenUuid) o[x.tokenUuid] = x.hit !== false;

return o;

} catch (_) { return null; }

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// Soulflare · Nidhogg (inner script, every client).

// A ranged soul-fire volley, one homing bolt per target (1..3; any count works). He rears back with the jaw parting

// (his rig's beamBreath, a short charge) while soul fire is drawn in from all round into his mouth; late in the charge

// one small soul-fire orb per target forms and circles there. At the peak the jaw snaps wide and the orbs leave one

// after the other (nearest target first, staggerMs apart), each a soul-fire head with a merged puff tail, fanned out

// on its own arc (the top target's bolt arcs high, the bottom one's low) and homing on its target's drawn body. Each

// bolt that HITS bursts on its target as a mass of soul-flame puffs flung out along its flight (white-hot flash,

// sparks, a hit stun: white-green flash + knock-back jolt, oni.hit, a shake), then small soul flames lick up the

// target's lower body for burnMs (the Burn status) with a faint green pulse on it. A MISSED bolt skims over the

// target's shoulder and fizzles out beyond it: no burst, no burn, no impact sound. The farthest target's bolt lands

// last, alone, and its burst is drawn at the same effect size as the near ones (not shrunk by depth), so it reads.

// The damage gate (fireDone) fires on the FIRST bolt's impact frame (BD has one gate per non-Chain action; every

// target is written then, and oni.impactOffsets tells BD to show each target's number when its own bolt lands;

// cfg.gateOn "last" restores the old gate, gateLagMs after the last bolt, with no offsets). The volley and the burn

// play on after it.

// Pixel FX (tier 1, ours): soul-fx-lib fireHead + puffField (Soul Tithe's soul-fire material) on a tile layer (CotM /

// Wailing Breath's, 128-px tiles made up front) at cfg.pixel screen px per effect px, updated every frame (60 fps);

// the glows are additive GPU sprites. Placed in the renderer's prerender, after the 3D camera has posed. The battle

// camera is left alone. Every sound goes through oni.sfx. No backticks in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const hits = ctx.params.hits || null;

props.description:
Nidhogg devours one of his Soul Fragments. It is destroyed, and he recovers 【twice its Max HP】 Mind Points.

The soul it held goes back to its owner without healing them: their Max HP is restored, but their current HP is not.
props.name: Soul Devour

props.description:
When a player character is reduced to 0 HP and is not saved by an effect that revives them at once, Nidhogg gains 1 Zero Power. That player is revived at full HP as a Nox Servant for the rest of the battle. Once per player.

A Nox Servant cannot be targeted by opponents, cannot take part in a Massive action, and cannot drop below 1 HP. Their Soul Fragment stays on the battlefield for good.
props.name: Zero Trigger: Nox Servant

// Requiem of Soul — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js

// Re-run: node tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js --out <file>

const CFG = {"singHold":2.6,"singJaw":24,"singHead":20,"singWings":-16,"tideMs":1450,"tideTravelMs":1400,"ringMs":300,"resLagMs":520,"resStaggerMs":190,"gateLagMs":280,"recedeMs":1300,"tailMs":1500,"pixel":3,"dim":0.36,"bankH":0.3,"maxPuffs":260,"bubbleRate":11,"dripRate":4.5,"checkLabel":"Requiem of Soul","holdMaxMs":38000,"reactStaggerMs":120,"totalTimeoutMs":50000,"sfx":[{"at":0,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness5.ogg","v":0.4},{"at":120,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Bell1.ogg","v":0.5},{"at":850,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Monster5.ogg","v":0.42},{"at":1100,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Wind1.ogg","v":0.5,"fadeAfter":2600,"fadeMs":800},{"at":1400,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Wind4.ogg","v":0.45,"fadeAfter":2000,"fadeMs":700},{"at":1500,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness4.ogg","v":0.45},{"at":2000,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Bell1.ogg","v":0.4}],"handSfx":[{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness2.ogg","v":0.32}]};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.nidhogg.requiem-of-soul";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Requiem of Soul]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

function hitMap() {

try {

const d = globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.experimental?.battleDirector?.getActiveDirector?.();

const r = d?.ctx?.actionResult?.perTargetResults;

if (!Array.isArray(r) || !r.length) return null;

const o = {};

for (const x of r) if (x?.tokenUuid) o[x.tokenUuid] = x.hit !== false;

return o;

} catch (_) { return null; }

}

// the cast's skill name = the Check Requester label save_check uses (GM only; null = the inner's cfg fallback)

function castSkillName() {

try {

const d = globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.experimental?.battleDirector?.getActiveDirector?.();

const n = d?.ctx?.actionResult?.skillName ?? d?.ctx?.skill?.name ?? null;

return n ? String(n) : null;

} catch (_) { return null; }

}

// a live Battle Director battle on the acting GM (D1: game.combat is unused there and Requiem rolls no accuracy,

// so hitMap() is null); broadcast to every client with the other params

function castInBattle() {

try {

const dc = globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.experimental?.battleDirector?.getActiveDirector?.()?.dCombat;

return !!(dc && dc.started && !dc.ended);

} catch (_) { return false; }

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// Requiem of Soul · Nidhogg (inner script, every client).

// He rears and SINGS (his rig's roar, held long and half open: a dirge, not a roar). Rings of sound and soul runes

// leave his throat; soul mist spills from his jaws to the floor and rolls out as a funeral TIDE over the whole party

// side (Overflow: everyone is in it). As the tide passes a target, ghostly hands rise out of the mist round its feet

// and a toxic haze clings to it. Then each target's save is shown, one by one:

// AFFLICT (failed save): the hands clench and drag, the haze is drawn into the body, a violet-green flash, then a

// lasting poisoned look: a pulsing sickly wash, bubbles rising off the body, drips running down into a pool.

// RESIST (passed save): a white shrug-off ring, the hands burst into motes, the mist is pushed back off it, a hop.

// The per-target part is the OUTCOME table below (afflictStart / afflictFrame / resistStart / resistFrame): the game

// can play only the afflict half on the targets that failed.

// HOLD, then REACT (2026-11-23, option A1): in a battle the saves are rolled AFTER the cast (RESOLVE's save_check opens

// the Check Requester), so the show cannot know the outcomes up front. Once the hands are up (RES0) it HOLDS (tide at

// its peak, hands flexing; still drawn every frame) until the local hook "oni:checkResolved" (cr-api.js closeOverlay,

// every client, as the check's dim lifts there) arrives for a check labelled with the cast's skill name (params.checkLabel,

// read by the outer script from the live action; else cfg.checkLabel, "Requiem of Soul") with

// results for its targets. Then each target plays ITS outcome (pass = resist, fail or no result = afflict, as the

// engine counts it), then the mist recedes. No result within cfg.holdMaxMs (38 s after hands up) = a neutral end: the hands sink, no

// outcome. Recorder / bench: cfg.autoResolveMs = fire that same hook itself that long after RES0, with cfg.fail (actor

// names) failing and the rest passing. Holding is on when cfg.hold is true, cfg.autoResolveMs is set, or (cfg.hold not

// false) a battle is running (params.inBattle from the live director, the scene flag directorState, params.hits, or game.combat.started) AND nobody is rolling by hand

// (a sim run / director harness: __FU_HARNESS_ACCEPT_PASSIVES__; their checks are silent). Not holding = the old preview:

// outcomes planned up front from cfg.fail, else params.hits (hit:false = resisted), else all afflicted.

// Gate: holding, fireDone (= the shell's oni:animationEnd) fires at the TRUE end, after the outcomes and the recede;

// the item's own timing ("Use Offset", offset = hands up) is what starts RESOLVE (and so the save) mid-show. Not

// holding, the old gate: fireDone after the last outcome. No outcome sounds of its own (the CR fanfare and the status

// batch's cue play at that moment).

// Pixels: one low-res frame per layer (K screen px per pixel, NEAREST), back layer under the battlers and front layer

// over them; buffers and textures are made before the show starts and only re-uploaded. Updated every frame (60 fps).

// No backticks in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const hits = ctx.params.hits || null;

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && !t.destroyed && t.mesh);

const readyHook = ctx.params.readyHook;

const ready = () => { if (readyHook) { try { Hooks.callAll(readyHook); } catch (e) {} } };

let gated = false;

const gate = () => { if (gated) return; gated = true; oni.fireDone(); };

if (!caster || !caster.mesh || !canvas || !canvas.ready) { ready(); gate(); return; }

// ── timing (ms from the start) ──

const HOLD = cfg.singHold != null ? cfg.singHold : 2.6; // seconds he holds the note

const ROAR_OPTS = { hold: HOLD, jaw: cfg.singJaw || 24, head: cfg.singHead || 20, wings: cfg.singWings || -16 };

const rigT = oni.rig.timing ? oni.rig.timing("roar", ROAR_OPTS) : null;

const PEAK = (rigT && rigT.peakMs) || 1100; // the jaw opens: the note starts

const SING_END = PEAK + HOLD * 1000;

const SPILL0 = PEAK + 60; // mist starts pouring from his jaws

const TIDE0 = cfg.tideMs || 1450; // the tide leaves the floor under his mouth

const TIDE_T = cfg.tideTravelMs || 1800; // ... and reaches the far edge of the screen

const HAND_DT = 120, HAND_RISE = 480; // after the front passes a target

const RES_LAG = cfg.resLagMs || 520, STAG = cfg.resStaggerMs || 190;

const AFF_MS = 520, RES_MS = 420; // the outcome beat itself

const RECEDE_MS = cfg.recedeMs || 1300;

const TAIL = cfg.tailMs || 1500; // poison look after the last outcome, then fade

const K = cfg.pixel || 3; // screen px per effect pixel

// hold-then-react

const FAR = 1e9; // "not planned yet" (finite: seg() of it stays 0)

const AUTO_MS = Number.isFinite(cfg.autoResolveMs) ? cfg.autoResolveMs : null;

// cap from hands up. RES0 (~the item offset 2700, up to ~3500) + HOLD_MAX + the neutral end (~2.4 s) must stay inside the

// director's 45 s true-end watch (director-animation.js armAnimationEndWatch), or a held show outlives its turn.

// Checked by tools/anim-studio/test/requiem-hold.test.mjs.

const HOLD_MAX = cfg.holdMaxMs != null ? cfg.holdMaxMs : 38000;

const REACT_STAG = cfg.reactStaggerMs != null ? cfg.reactStaggerMs : 120; // between targets once the results are in

// the check it waits for: save_check labels it with the cast's skill name (ctx.skill.name), so a renamed or "(Variant)"

// copy still matches. The outer script reads that name from the live action on the acting GM and broadcasts it.

const LABEL_RAW = String(ctx.params.checkLabel || cfg.checkLabel || "Requiem of Soul").trim();

const CHECK_LABEL = LABEL_RAW.toLowerCase();

// <hold-decision> (evaluated alone by tools/anim-studio/test/requiem-hold.test.mjs: keep it self-contained)

// "in battle" (D1 fix 2026-11-23): a Battle Director battle does not use game.combat, and Requiem has no accuracy roll,

// so params.hits is null there. Any ONE of: params.inBattle (the outer reads the live director on the acting GM and

// broadcasts it), this client's scene flag directorState (written by the host's persistence, readable on every client;

// same test as battle-focus.js battleHere), params.hits, a started Foundry combat.

const BD_FLAG = (() => {

try {

const sc = globalThis.canvas && globalThis.canvas.scene;

const st = sc && sc.getFlag ? sc.getFlag("fabula-ultima-companion", "directorState") : null;

const dc = st && st.dCombat;

return !!(dc && dc.started && !dc.ended && Array.isArray(dc.combatants) && dc.combatants.length);

} catch (e) { return false; }

})();

const P_IN_BATTLE = !!(ctx && ctx.params && ctx.params.inBattle === true);

const inBattle = P_IN_BATTLE || BD_FLAG || !!hits || !!(globalThis.game && globalThis.game.combat && globalThis.game.combat.started);

// nobody rolls by hand: SimMode.begin() always sets this (sim checks are forced silent), as does the director harness

// when it accepts passives. The silent check reports at once anyway (cr-api.js MSG_RESOLVED); not holding is the

// defence in depth, so an unattended battle never waits on the hook.

const UNATTENDED = !!globalThis.__FU_HARNESS_ACCEPT_PASSIVES__;

const HOLDING = cfg.hold === true || AUTO_MS != null || (cfg.hold !== false && inBattle && !UNATTENDED);

// </hold-decision>

// ── space ── (same helpers as Call of the Master: effect px = world px x D, 1 effect px = 1 screen px at rest)

const S3 = () => globalThis.__ONI_BATTLE_STAGE_3D__ || null;

let D = 1;

try { const v = globalThis.FUCompanion.api.camera.restViewFor(canvas.scene); if (v && v.scale > 0) D = v.scale; } catch (e) {}

if (!(D > 0)) D = canvas.stage.scale.x || 1;

const meshBox2d = (tok) => {

try {

const b = tok.mesh.getBounds(false);

if (b && b.width > 0) {

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.primary.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(b.x, b.y), c = inv(b.x + b.width, b.y + b.height);

return { x0: a.x, y0: a.y, w: c.x - a.x, h: c.y - a.y };

}

} catch (e) {}

return { x0: tok.x, y0: tok.y, w: tok.w, h: tok.h };

};

const bodyBox = (tok) => {

try {

const s = S3(); const b = s && s.drawnMeshBounds ? s.drawnMeshBounds(tok) : tok.mesh.getBounds(false);

if (b && b.width > 0) {

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(b.x, b.y), c = inv(b.x + b.width, b.y + b.height);

return { x0: a.x, y0: a.y, w: c.x - a.x, h: c.y - a.y };

}

} catch (e) {}

return meshBox2d(tok);

};

const screenRectE = () => {

const r = canvas.app.renderer, W = r.screen.width, H = r.screen.height;

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(0, 0), b = inv(W, H);

Nidhogg draws the life of every other Soul Fragment into the strongest one, the fragment with the most HP. It takes in all of their current HP and may rise above its Max HP. Needs 2 or more Soul Fragments.

The drained fragments shatter. Their owners get their Max HP back, but not their current HP.

props.description:
• Massive

Nidhogg breathes out a wailing gale of soul-poison. Deal 【300】 Poison damage to one enemy. This spell always hits.

The damage is divided equally among all of its targets (rounded down). Each player character it is not aimed at is dealt a Join card, and may play it to step in as an additional target.

// the fire: the runtime's own (override), or our stepped glow where there is none

else if (look.flare > 0.02) { glow(LF, ci, cj - (g.p.h / K) * 0.1, (g.p.w / K) * (0.45 + 0.2 * look.flare), SOULB[3], 0.35 * look.flare); }

const ms = realNow() - r0; cost.n++; cost.sum += ms; if (ms > cost.max) { cost.max = ms; cost.maxAt = Math.round(el); }

try {

rtMark("warm");

// ── run ──

let rig = null;

try { rig = oni.rig.roar(caster, ROAR_OPTS); } catch (e) { console.warn(TAG, "roar failed", e); } // a throw here must not skip the gate

rtMark("rig");

t0 = performance.now();

ready();

for (const c of cfg.sfx || []) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.6, delay: c.at != null ? c.at : 0, fadeAfter: c.fadeAfter || 0, fadeMs: c.fadeMs || 400 }); } catch (e) {} }

// per fragment: a lash as each tether leaves, a ghostly rise as it lands

for (const g of G) {

const rdr = canvas.app.renderer;

const onPre = () => { if (rdr.renderingToScreen === false) return; try { frame(); } catch (e) { console.warn(TAG, "frame threw", e); } };

rdr.on("prerender", onPre);

try {

await wait(PEAK);

try { oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.shakeMs || 520, intensity: cfg.shake || 6 }); } catch (e) {}

await wait(Math.max(0, UNI - PEAK));

try { oni.screenshake({ duration: 300, intensity: 3 }); } catch (e) {}

await wait(Math.max(0, GATE - UNI));

gate();

await wait(Math.max(0, TOTAL - GATE));

LB.destroy(); LF.destroy();

`;

try {

// Claw — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js

// Re-run: node tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js --out <file>

(async () => {

const CFG = {"peakMs":500,"leadMs":60,"staggerMs":170,"gateLagMs":150,"markScale":0.85,"totalTimeoutMs":10000,"sfx":[{"at":0,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Monster2.ogg","v":0.45},{"at":380,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_SWINGB.wav","v":0.6}],"hitSfx":[{"dt":-20,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitSlashL.ogg","v":0.7},{"dt":40,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_HITNIKUA.wav","v":0.45}]};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.nidhogg.claw";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Claw]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

function hitMap() {

try {

const d = globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.experimental?.battleDirector?.getActiveDirector?.();

const r = d?.ctx?.actionResult?.perTargetResults;

if (!Array.isArray(r) || !r.length) return null;

const o = {};

for (const x of r) if (x?.tokenUuid) o[x.tokenUuid] = x.hit !== false;

return o;

} catch (_) { return null; }

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// Claw · Nidhogg (inner script, every client).

// He rears up and slams his head down (his 3D rig's clawSwipe, the slam at 0.5 s); with the slam, three claw marks

// rake each target he hit, one target after the other: white-hot, cooling through his soul green to a glowing green

// burn, with green flecks and drips (the Bleed, in his colour), a green bloom, and a little of his soul fire left

// burning along the marks for ~0.6 s (CotM's merged soul-flame puff field: rising puffs + light, hot at the base). A missed target gets no marks and no impact sound. oni.hit per target as its last mark lands; the

// damage gate (fireDone) a beat after the last target.

// Pixel FX: stock pixelfx melee/claw-swipe (vendored under pixel-entrance/pixelfx/fx/melee, recoloured), one small

// frame per target at K screen px per effect px, placed on the target's drawn body (3D camera: drawnMeshBounds);

// the soul flame is soul-fx-lib puffField drawn into the same frame; the bloom is one soft additive GPU sprite.

// Every sound goes through oni.sfx. No backticks in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const hits = ctx.params.hits || null;

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && !t.destroyed && t.mesh);

const readyHook = ctx.params.readyHook;

const ready = () => { if (readyHook) { try { Hooks.callAll(readyHook); } catch (e) {} } };

let gated = false;

const gate = () => { if (gated) return; gated = true; oni.fireDone(); };

if (!caster || !caster.mesh || !canvas || !canvas.ready) { ready(); gate(); return; }

const route = (p) => { try { return foundry.utils.getRoute(p); } catch (e) { return "/" + p; } };

const PXD = "modules/fabula-ultima-companion/scripts/battle-director/pixel-entrance/pixelfx/";

let PX = null, FXM = null, LIB = null, SL = null;

try {

PX = await import(route(PXD + "core/index.js"));

FXM = await import(route(PXD + "fx/melee/claw-swipe.js"));

LIB = await import(route(PXD + "fx/melee/_lib.js"));

SL = await import(route("modules/fabula-ultima-companion/scripts/conflict-event/soul-fx/soul-fx-lib.js"));

} catch (e) { console.warn("[ONI][Claw] pixel fx unavailable", e); }

// ── timing (ms from the start) ──

const rigT = oni.rig.timing ? oni.rig.timing("clawSwipe") : null;

const PEAK = (rigT && rigT.peakMs) || cfg.peakMs || 500;

const RIG_END = (rigT && rigT.durationMs) || 1250;

const LEAD = cfg.leadMs != null ? cfg.leadMs : 60; // the slam -> the first target's marks land

const STAG = cfg.staggerMs != null ? cfg.staggerMs : 170; // one target to the next

const MARK_HIT = 120; // the stock effect's last (heavy) mark lands 0.12 s in

const FX_MS = 900;

const LINGER = cfg.lingerMs != null ? cfg.lingerMs / 1000 : 0.6; // the soul flame keeps burning on the marks (s)

const FLAME_END = 80 + 100 + LINGER * 1000 + 320; // last puff gone, ms after fxAt

const GATE_LAG = cfg.gateLagMs != null ? cfg.gateLagMs : 150;

const TG = targets.map((t, i) => {

const hitAt = PEAK + LEAD + i * STAG;

return { tok: t, i, hitAt, fxAt: hitAt - MARK_HIT, hit: hits ? hits[t.document.uuid] !== false : true, fx: null, done: false };

});

const LAST = TG.length ? TG[TG.length - 1].hitAt : PEAK + LEAD;

const GATE = LAST + GATE_LAG;

const TOTAL = Math.max(cfg.totalMs || 0, RIG_END + 50, TG.length ? TG[TG.length - 1].fxAt + Math.max(FX_MS, FLAME_END) + 50 : 0);

if (cfg.debug) globalThis.__nidPlan = { move: "claw", PEAK, GATE, TOTAL, hits: TG.map((g) => ({ name: g.tok.name, at: g.hitAt, hit: g.hit })) };

// ── space ──

const S3 = () => globalThis.__ONI_BATTLE_STAGE_3D__ || null;

let D = 1;

try { const v = globalThis.FUCompanion.api.camera.restViewFor(canvas.scene); if (v && v.scale > 0) D = v.scale; } catch (e) {}

if (!(D > 0)) D = canvas.stage.scale.x || 1;

// a token's drawn body box in world px

const bodyBox = (tok) => {

try {

const s = S3(); const b = s && s.drawnMeshBounds ? s.drawnMeshBounds(tok) : tok.mesh.getBounds(false);

if (b && b.width > 0) {

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(b.x, b.y), c = inv(b.x + b.width, b.y + b.height);

return { x0: a.x, y0: a.y, w: c.x - a.x, h: c.y - a.y };

}

} catch (e) {}

return { x0: tok.x, y0: tok.y, w: tok.w, h: tok.h };

};

// ── layer: one frame per hit target (colour + additive light sprite), effect px = screen px x K ──

const root = new PIXI.Container(); root.name = "oni-nidhogg-claw"; root.eventMode = "none"; root.scale.set(1 / D); root.zIndex = 95000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true; canvas.stage.addChild(root);

// his soul ramp (soul-fx-lib SOUL): the mark's core white-hot, cooling through soul green to a dark green burn

const PAL = cfg.palette || ["#03140b", "#0a3019", "#11522a", "#1d7d3b", "#34b04d", "#5dff6e", "#b4ffba", "#ffffff"];

const SPK = cfg.sparks || ["#dcffd2", "#a6ff9c", "#5dff6e", "#22a86c"];

const GLOW_TINT = 0x5dff6e;

const FW = 150, FH = 124, OX = 40, OY = 100; // frame size and the effect's origin in it

const MX = 30, MY = -21, MH = 34; // the marks' centre (from the origin) and their height, effect px

const bufTex = (buf) => PIXI.Texture.fromBuffer(new Uint8Array(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, FW * FH * 4), FW, FH, { scaleMode: PIXI.SCALE_MODES.NEAREST, alphaMode: PIXI.ALPHA_MODES.UNPACK });

// the soft bloom: one radial texture for the run, drawn additive and tinted green over each target's marks

let bloomTex = null;

const getBloomTex = () => {

if (bloomTex) return bloomTex;

const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = 128;

const c2 = cv.getContext("2d"), gr = c2.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 0, 64, 64, 64);

gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)"); gr.addColorStop(0.35, "rgba(255,255,255,0.45)"); gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");

c2.fillStyle = gr; c2.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);

return (bloomTex = PIXI.Texture.from(cv));

};

// the marks as the stock effect draws them (claw-swipe.js: through(31 + 8i, -23 + 2i, 1.84, 1, 40, 0.84 - 0.05i, 0.5),

// width 4.2 - 0.4i, opening at 0.04i s): where each mark's soul flame burns, in frame px

const MARKS = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => {

const s = LIB ? LIB.through(31 + i * 8, -23 + i * 2, 1.84, 1, 40, 0.84 - i * 0.05, 0.5) : null, W = 4.2 - i * 0.4;

const pts = [];

if (s) for (let k = 0; k <= 8; k++) { const q = LIB.onSwing(s, s.R - W / 2, s.span * (0.12 + 0.76 * k / 8)); pts.push([OX + q[0], OY + q[1]]); }

return { open: i * 0.04 + 0.035, pts };

});

let seedR = 0x2545F491;

const R = () => { seedR ^= seedR << 13; seedR ^= seedR >>> 17; seedR ^= seedR << 5; return ((seedR >>> 0) % 100000) / 100000; };

const rr = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

// a soul-flame puff (CotM's): rises and slows; puffField merges them, hottest where they are young and dense

const spawnPuff = (L, x, y, k) => L.push({ kind: "puff", x, y, vx: rr(-6, 6), vy: -rr(18, 42), age: 0, life: rr(0.16, 0.3) * (0.7 + 0.4 * k), s: rr(1.3, 2.3) * (0.6 + 0.5 * k), f: R() });

const stepPuffs = (L, dt) => { for (let i = L.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const q = L[i]; q.age += dt; if (q.age >= q.life) { L.splice(i, 1); continue; } q.x += q.vx * dt; q.y += q.vy * dt; q.vx *= Math.pow(0.2, dt); q.vy *= Math.pow(0.55, dt); } };

// how hard a mark still burns u s into the effect: full as it tears open, then dying over LINGER

const burnK = (u, open) => { const v = u - open; return v < 0 ? 0 : v < 0.1 ? 1 : Math.max(0, 1 - (v - 0.1) / LINGER); };

function makeFx(g) {

const frame = PX.createFrame(FW, FH);

const fx = PX.createFx(FXM, { x: OX, y: OY, palette: PAL, sparks: SPK, seed: 8 + g.i * 5, light: cfg.lightK || 1.3 });

const cs = new PIXI.Sprite(bufTex(frame.color)), ls = new PIXI.Sprite(bufTex(frame.light));

ls.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const bl = new PIXI.Sprite(getBloomTex()); bl.anchor.set(0.5); bl.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; bl.tint = GLOW_TINT; bl.alpha = 0;

root.addChild(bl, cs, ls);

const bb = bodyBox(g.tok);

const K = Math.max(2, Math.min(4, Math.round((bb.h * D * (cfg.markScale || 0.7)) / MH)));

return { frame, fx, cs, ls, bl, K, last: 0, puffs: [], fxDone: false };

}

function placeFx(g) {

const bb = bodyBox(g.tok), F = g.fx, K = F.K;

const cx = (bb.x0 + bb.w / 2) * D, cy = (bb.y0 + bb.h * 0.42) * D;

for (const s of [F.cs, F.ls]) { s.scale.set(K); s.position.set(Math.round(cx - (OX + MX) * K), Math.round(cy - (OY + MY) * K)); }

F.bl.position.set(cx, cy); F.bl.scale.set((MH * K * (cfg.bloomSize || 2.4)) / 128);

}

function dropFx(g) {

const F = g.fx; if (!F) return;

for (const s of [F.cs, F.ls]) { try { s.parent && s.parent.removeChild(s); s.destroy({ texture: true, baseTexture: true }); } catch (e) {} }

try { F.bl.parent && F.bl.parent.removeChild(F.bl); F.bl.destroy({ texture: false }); } catch (e) {}

g.fx = null;

}

// ── the show ──

let t0 = 0, lastSim = -1, tickFn = null, nHit = 0;

const cost = { n: 0, sum: 0, max: 0 };

function tick() {

const c0 = performance.now(), el = c0 - t0;

// the damage beat per target, on every client (the presenter listens for oni:hit)

for (const g of TG) {

if (g.done || el < g.hitAt) continue;

g.done = true;

try { oni.hit({ tokenUuid: g.tok.document.uuid, hit: g.hit }); } catch (e) {}

if (g.hit) { nHit++; try { oni.screenshake({ duration: nHit === 1 ? 240 : 200, intensity: nHit === 1 ? 6 : 4 }); } catch (e) {} }

}

if (!PX || !FXM) return;

// pixels at 30 fps

if (lastSim >= 0 && el - lastSim < 33) return;

lastSim = el;

for (const g of TG) {

if (!g.hit || el < g.fxAt) continue;

if (!g.fx && !g.gone) { try { g.fx = makeFx(g); } catch (e) { g.gone = true; console.warn("[ONI][Claw] fx build failed", e); continue; } }

const F = g.fx; if (!F) continue;

const u = Math.min((el - g.fxAt) / 1000, FLAME_END / 1000 + 0.2), dts = Math.max(0, u - F.last);

if (dts > 0) { if (!F.fxDone) F.fx.update(dts); F.last = u; }

if (!F.fxDone && F.fx.done()) F.fxDone = true;

// the soul flame left burning on the marks: front-loaded as each tears open, dying over LINGER

let burning = 0;

for (const m of MARKS) {

const k = burnK(u, m.open); if (k <= 0) continue;

burning++;

const n = (u - m.open < 0.1 ? 2.0 : 1.1 * Math.pow(k, 1.4)) * (cfg.flameRate || 1);

for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) if (R() < n / 3) { const q = m.pts[Math.floor(R() * m.pts.length)]; if (q) spawnPuff(F.puffs, q[0] + rr(-1, 1), q[1] + rr(-1, 1), k); }

}

stepPuffs(F.puffs, dts);

if (F.fxDone && !burning && !F.puffs.length) { dropFx(g); g.gone = true; continue; }

PX.clearFrame(F.frame);

if (!F.fxDone) F.fx.draw(F.frame, "front");

if (SL && F.puffs.length) SL.puffField(PX.painterFor(F.frame), F.puffs, u);

// the bloom: flares green as the marks land, then breathes down with the flame

const hitU = MARK_HIT / 1000, flare = u < hitU ? Math.max(0, (u - 0.02) / (hitU - 0.02)) : Math.exp(-(u - hitU) / 0.18);

F.bl.alpha = (cfg.bloomAlpha || 0.5) * Math.max(flare, 0.35 * burnK(u, MARKS[2].open));

for (const s of [F.cs, F.ls]) { try { s.texture.baseTexture.resource.update(); } catch (e) {} }

placeFx(g);

}

const dt = performance.now() - c0; cost.n++; cost.sum += dt; if (dt > cost.max) cost.max = dt;

if (cfg.debug) globalThis.__nidCost = { avg: +(cost.sum / cost.n).toFixed(3), max: +cost.max.toFixed(3), n: cost.n };

}

// ── run ──

const rig = oni.rig.play(caster, "clawSwipe", {});

t0 = performance.now();

ready();

for (const c of cfg.sfx || []) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.6, delay: c.at || 0 }); } catch (e) {} }

for (const g of TG) {

if (!g.hit) continue;

for (const c of cfg.hitSfx || []) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.6, delay: Math.max(0, g.hitAt + (c.dt || 0)) }); } catch (e) {} }

}

const tkr = canvas.app.ticker;

tickFn = () => { try { tick(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[ONI][Claw] frame threw", e); } };

tkr.add(tickFn);

try {

await wait(GATE);

tick();

gate();

await wait(Math.max(0, TOTAL - GATE));

try { await Promise.race([rig.done, wait(800)]); } catch (e) {}

} finally {

try { tkr.remove(tickFn); } catch (e) {}

for (const g of TG) dropFx(g);

try { root.parent && root.parent.removeChild(root); root.destroy({ children: true }); } catch (e) {}

gate();

}

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 10000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, hits: hitMap(), strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Claw" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

Nox Servant. When a player character is reduced to 0 HP and is not saved by an effect that revives them at once, Nidhogg gains 1 Zero Power. That player is revived at full HP as a Nox Servant: opponents cannot target them, they cannot take part in a Massive action, and they cannot drop below 1 HP. Their Soul Fragment stays on the battlefield for the rest of the battle.

Oath of Servitude. At the moment every player character is a Nox Servant, the battle enters the Crystal Round until the end of the battle. The Crystal gains half of the dragon's remaining HP. At the end of each round Nidhogg gains 1 Zero Power.
